Name: Amaro Chick White Chicken Replacer
Author: DigiC300
Description:
Replaces the white chicken with the Amaro Chick from FFXIV!

Amaros are camel-birds that are the primary mount in the First from Norvrandt (from the FFXIV Shadowbringers Expansion)

Just extract the files to your mod folder! Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher
